settings.title: Agent Settings
settings.goalHint: Configure /opennexus-goal auto-continue: after each turn an evaluation model checks whether the goal is met, and the session continues automatically if not. Works with every agent, independent of an agent's native /goal (e.g. Claude Code).
settings.goalAgentHint: Agent and model used to evaluate whether the goal is met, selected together. Defaults to the session's own agent with its default model.
settings.goalMaxTurnsHint: Auto-continue stops after this many turns. 0 means the default (20 turns).
settings.goalMaxDurationHint: Auto-continue stops once the goal has been active longer than this. 0 means the default (60 minutes).
settings.goalRolesHint: File-based definitions (*.md under {{dir}}): frontmatter declares name/description with optional agent/model/skills; the body is the evaluation prompt template (supports {{condition}} / {{transcript}} placeholders). On the first evaluation after a goal is set, the best-matching role is picked automatically based on the goal condition; without a match the default evaluation settings above are used.
settings.goalRolesEmpty: No evaluation roles yet. Enter a name below to create one.
settings.goalRoleDeleteConfirm: Delete evaluation role "{{name}}"? The corresponding .md file will be removed.
settings.goalRoleTemplateDesc: One sentence describing the target goal type (required; used for auto-selection)
settings.goalRoleTemplateBody: The body is the evaluation prompt template; use {{condition}} / {{transcript}} placeholders, or omit them to have the body appended as evaluation guidance before the standard sections.
settings.classifyHint: Configure the agent, model and prompt for automatic note tagging and title generation. Runs in a dedicated task session in the default workspace; open「Note classify task」in the sidebar to view each run.
settings.configHint: Manage Skills, Commands, and Rules scan path configuration. Scan directories are reloaded automatically after saving. Skills only apply to external SKILL.md files.
settings.taskHint: Configure automatic behavior when starting a task: auto-tag based on the description and generate a title with AI. Runs in a throwaway session and does not affect the main conversation.
settings.autoTagHint: When starting a task, the AI picks the best-matching tags from your predefined list based on the task description.
settings.autoTitleHint: When starting a task, the AI generates a short title from the prompt (replaces the default first-line truncation).
settings.predefinedTagsHint: The AI only picks from these tags. Add or remove freely.
settings.tagPromptHint: Placeholders: {{tags}} (predefined tags), {{prompt}} (task description). Leave blank for default.
settings.titlePromptHint: Placeholder: {{prompt}} (task description). Leave blank for default.
settings.permissionHint: Configure global permission lists (apply to all sessions). Rules match the tool title reported by the agent, supporting * wildcards (e.g. Bash(git status *)). Priority: deny > allow > ask. Enable YOLO per task from the task header.
settings.permissionModeNormal: Standard: match against lists, ask when unmatched
settings.permissionAllowHint: One rule per line. Matches are auto-approved without confirmation.
settings.permissionAskHint: One rule per line. Matches always prompt, even in YOLO mode.
settings.permissionDenyHint: One rule per line. Matches are auto-rejected with highest priority.
settings.noteClassifyIntervalHint: Wait at least this long after a note is created or updated before auto-classifying; skipped when no notes are pending
settings.envHint: One KEY=VALUE per line. These will be injected into the launched agent process. Use HTTPS_PROXY / HTTP_PROXY / NO_PROXY for proxy settings.
settings.resetToRegistryNotFound: This agent is not in the built-in registry, cannot reset

settings.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete this agent configuration?
settings.hint: Add local ACP-compatible agents (Claude Code, CodeBuddy, Devin, etc.) here. Configurations are shared globally. Built-in agents are managed by config.yaml.
settings.defaultAgentModel: Default Agent · Model (auto-selected when creating tasks)
settings.defaultAgentModelHint: Same combined dropdown as the new-task page; picking an agent-only entry uses the agent's own default model, and the visibility filters below apply here too
settings.defaultModelHint: Model auto-selected for the default agent when creating tasks; leave empty to use the agent's own default
settings.selectorFiltersListHint: Pick the Agent · Model combos to show via the dropdown (all checked = no filtering, so newly probed models also show). The list comes from each agent's probed models; agents without probed models appear as a single entry. Saved to config.yaml and takes effect immediately.
settings.selectorFiltersHint: One regex per line (case-insensitive), matched as substring against both "agentType/modelValue" and "agentType/modelName" (e.g. claude-code/sonnet, swe). A combo is shown in the new-task dropdown if any regex matches; leave empty to show all. Toggling checkboxes rewrites these rules.
settings.validationError: Type, display name and command are required
settings.noteClassifyAgentHint: Auto-tag notes on create/edit using this agent; leave empty to use manual #tags only
settings.noteClassifyAgentUnavailable: {{type}} (disabled, pick "No" or another agent and save)
settings.noteClassifyPromptHint: Supports {{content}} (note body) and {{existing_tags}} (existing tags); default output is a JSON object with tags and title
settings.noteMcpHint: Generate a token once so external clients and local agents can read notes via HTTP MCP. Token cannot be rotated.
settings.noteMcpAuthHint: External clients should send Authorization: Bearer <token>

system.title: System
system.hint: Reload the configuration and program so newly added Skills / Rules / Commands are picked up.
system.desktopHint: The desktop app will restart the backend process and refresh the page. In-progress tasks will be marked as interrupted and can be resumed from the task list.
system.browserHint: Hot-reloads scan directory configuration without restarting the process. Takes effect immediately only for new sessions; existing sessions must be recreated after reload to apply new rules.

configEditor.skillsDesc: Configure external Skills directories (agentskills.io spec: recursively scan subdirectories for SKILL.md)
configEditor.commandsDesc: Configure Slash Command directories (Claude Code spec: recursively scan *.md, supports subdirectories and symlinks)
configEditor.rulesDesc: Configure Rule scan paths (directories or single files, e.g. CLAUDE.md)
configEditor.subagentsDesc: Configure subagent scan directories (markdown files: frontmatter with name/description/model/tools, body as system_prompt; used by agents with native subagent support)
configEditor.scanSkillsHint: Scan skill files in configured paths
configEditor.scanCommandsHint: Scan command files in configured paths
configEditor.saveSuccess: Configuration saved and scan directories auto-reloaded.
configEditor.scanRulesHint: Scan rule files in configured paths
configEditor.scanSubAgentsHint: Scan subagent definition files in configured paths
configEditor.mcpDesc: Configure globally shared MCP servers (standard mcpServers format), injected into all agent sessions. Saved changes take effect immediately for new sessions.
configEditor.mcpEditorHint: Edit mcpServers config (JSON). Entries without a type field default to stdio (command/args/env); http / sse use url/headers.
configEditor.mcpSaved: MCP configuration saved, takes effect for new sessions
configEditor.mcpInvalidJson: MCP configuration is not valid JSON
configEditor.rawConfigDesc: Edit the server's config.yaml directly. YAML syntax and config rules are validated before saving; invalid content is never written. Scan directories hot-reload automatically, while other options take effect after a service restart.
configEditor.rawEditorHint: Edit the full config.yaml (YAML). The format is validated automatically before saving; invalid content will not be written.
configEditor.rawSaved: Config saved; some options take effect after a service restart
configEditor.gatewayDesc: Aggregates the http/sse MCP servers configured above into a single endpoint. Many ACP agents ignore the mcpServers parameter of session/new and must be configured in their own config file; with the gateway that manual step is done once, and adding or removing MCP servers later needs no agent config changes. Once enabled, those upstreams are no longer injected into sessions individually but exposed through the gateway, with tools named server_tool.
configEditor.gatewayEnabled: Gateway enabled; takes effect for new sessions
configEditor.gatewayDisabled: Gateway disabled; upstreams are injected into sessions directly again
configEditor.gatewayNoToken: No MCP token yet. Generate one in Notes settings before enabling the gateway.
configEditor.gatewaySnippetsDesc: For agents that ignore session/new mcpServers, add the snippet below to their config file. You only need to do this once.
configEditor.gatewaySnippetJson: Generic JSON (Claude Code / Gemini / Qwen / iFlow / Cursor)
configEditor.gatewayLinkDesc: Aggregates multiple MCP servers into a single endpoint; now on its own page
configEditor.gatewayAddCustomTitle: Add custom upstream (not written to mcp.json)
configEditor.gatewayAddCustomHint: Add an externally hosted MCP server (http/sse). Authenticate with a Bearer token or custom headers. For stdio servers, configure them in mcp.json below to be injected directly into sessions.
configEditor.gatewayCustomBearerPlaceholder: optional; leave empty to skip Authorization
